display_text: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) ** [[Fortification|Fortification +75%]][[Fortification|Fortification +75%]]: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 75% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.[[Category:Fortification +75% items]] → [[Fortification|Fortification +100%]][[Fortification|Fortification +100%]]: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.[[Category:Fortification +100% items]] ** Adds [[Dodge bonus| Dodge +4%]][[Dodge bonus| Dodge +4%]]: +4% [[Enhancement bonus]] to Dodge.[[Category: Dodge +4% items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
